messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up — evening rackstage is hitting a wiring hold on the GPU queue. One cabinet's PCIe riser cable didn't seat; procurement says new cable kit arrives tomorrow. Can we route jobs to spare nodes to avoid reservation slippage? @sasha @raj
sasha: Which cabinet exactly? I saw an alert for rack7 but want to be sure. If it's rack7 we can failover to rack3 spare nodes for the next 6-8 hrs. Need ops-night signoff.
raj: Confirmed it's rack7, slots s04 and s05. Physical team reseated the riser but BMC still shows no NVMe devices on those slots. Initial suspect: PDU sequencing/LOM power race. I'm triaging logs now.
evelyn: If we move active reservations we need to update the capacity mapping and notify billing. I can patch the reservation table but need the node IDs and exact time window.
raj: Node IDs: gpu-r7-s04, gpu-r7-s05. Spare pool available: gpu-r3-s12,gpu-r3-s13,gpu-r3-s14,gpu-r3-s15 (4 nodes). Proposal: route canary + low-latency reservations to gpu-r3-s12/13 for 2 hours, keep capacity reservations intact, then reassess. ops-night, can you execute a temporary reroute? infra-bot, tag deploy.
ops-night: OK — running reroute now. Command I'm using:
```
redwood capacity reroute --from rack7 --to rack3 --nodes gpu-r3-s12,gpu-r3-s13 --window 2h --preserve-reservations
```
ops-night: Reroute completed. Telemetry: p50 latency +2ms, p95 unchanged, no increase in error rate. Jobs have been relocated, reservations retained for 2h.
jordan: Great. @evelyn please update the booking matrix and add a note for follow-up. @sasha can you chase procurement on cable ETA and confirm whether we can get an expedited install window tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC?
sasha: Pinged vendor. Current ETA 24h, asking for expedited 8-12h window. Vendor replied: "expedite request logged; tentative install 2026-03-18 03:30Z pending crew confirmation." Will update when confirmed.
raj: Also capturing PDU log snippet for ticket: "seq-failure at 2026-03-17T01:12Z — downstream outlet tripped then reseated; device enumeration failed post reseat". I'll open a hardware ticket and assign to ops-night for hardware-level follow-up.
evelyn: Booking updated: temporary reroute recorded, reservation mapping patched to point active requests to gpu-r3-s12/13 for 2h. Billing tagged: dev-cost-adjust. Note added: "followup: rack7 riser cable + PDU sequence investigation".
jordan: Thanks everyone. We'll leave this thread open until vendor confirms install or we see >5% error/latency regression. Reopen if issues crop up. :thumbsup:
